programme.desc: Sophie is keen to take her mind off her upcoming hearing with the hospital board but in doing so, makes a bad situation worse and must face some uncomfortable truths about her own behaviour. Bec's attempting to do it all - maintain the salon, mediate between Frances and Jenny and her parents - plus the added pressure of a first pregnancy.
